categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes private broadcast connection lifecycle and node finalization in src/net_processing.cpp and src/private_broadcast.cpp under P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents an origin deanonymization leak where returning transactions early could cancel remaining connections. The PR description notes it addresses 'theoretical timing attacks' where an adversary returning a transaction quickly could correlate broadcasters, directly impacting the privacy of transaction origin which P2P treats as a top priority.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes to test_runner.py, fuzz tests, and functional tests specifically support the private broadcast P2P changes rather than test framework infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Category explicitly excludes tests that pin the behavior of a specific functional area like P2P relay.
